_comment: Single source of truth for negotiation tiers and product coverage panels. Synchronized verbatim with wordtoword.md. Order: 1: vsc (7-Year Bumper-to-Bumper), 2: tire_wheel (5-Year Tire & Wheel), 3: maintenance (4-Year Maintenance), 4: gap (GAP Protection).

vsc.label: 7-Year Bumper-to-Bumper
vsc.title: 7-Year / 100,000-Mile Bumper-to-Bumper Warranty
vsc.description: True blanket cover warranty protecting against wear and tear failures — the engine, transmission, AC, electronics, parts, and labor with zero deductible.
bullets: Zero deductible at any service location across the metroplex

tire_wheel.label: 5-Year Tire & Wheel
tire_wheel.title: 5-Year Tire and Wheel Cover
tire_wheel.description: Texas roads and highway construction cause potholes and blowouts — covers 2 complete sets of tires and wheels for the next 5 years.
bullets: Covers 2 sets of tires over next 5 years (8 tires total)
Three hundred fifty dollar replacement value per tire
Hundred twenty-five dollar installation covered per tire
Almost four thousand dollars in out-of-pocket savings
Zero deductible on road hazard punctures, blowouts & rim damage

maintenance.label: 4-Year Maintenance Package
maintenance.title: 4-Year Maintenance Package
maintenance.description: Routine scheduled maintenance fully taken care of for the next 4 years — say goodbye to service desk invoices.
bullets: Full synthetic oil changes ($125 value each included)
Engine and cabin air filter replacements ($29 value each included)
Tire rotations and inspections ($140 value each included)
Zero maintenance bills — only thing you have to worry about is paying for GAS!

gap.label: GAP Coverage
gap.title: GAP Coverage
gap.description: Covers the gap between insurance payout and loan balance in the event of collision, theft, hail storm, or flood total loss.
bullets: Covers difference between insurance payout and loan balance
Total loss protection for accident, theft, hail, and flood
Zero out-of-pocket loan debt remaining on a totaled vehicle
